domains.objective: Trade pressure, throughput, latency, and cost without violating authority or safety budgets.
Relate queue pressure to execution velocity with bounded acceleration and explicit overload response.
Conserve durable work identity and mutation intent across retries, restarts, and compute replacement.
Account for work entering, leaving, waiting in, and mutating through each Cell boundary.
Represent competing implementations and trust zones explicitly without accidental authority blending.
Control how much exploratory, liquid, mixed, and supercritical work may coexist under finite capacity.
Seed diverse branches from stable contracts while keeping lineage and ownership deterministic.
Detect retry heat that turns laminar work into mixed or turbulent execution before storms form.
Condense compatible branches into shared interfaces while preserving evidence and deleting no alternatives yet.
Drive concurrency to deliberate stress limits while bounding damage, cost, and scheduler load.
Shed or hold work predictably when sudden load exceeds safe control-plane or provider capacity.
Coalesce high-rate events and wakeups so propagation speed cannot create duplicate lifecycle scheduling.
Move tiny low-risk changes quickly without bypassing Cell identity, evidence, or required gates.
Keep interfaces cohesive under branch pressure and refuse changes that tear authority boundaries.
Translate priority gradients into fair movement without starvation, hidden preemption, or policy drift.
Route through heterogeneous providers and capacity holes without losing lineage or deterministic refusal.
Propagate evidence summaries across operator surfaces while retaining one canonical ledger.
Move ready work toward available capacity using Airflow-owned dispatch and explicit admission signals.
Treat retry, model, compute, and operator effort as bounded thermal load with measurable dissipation.
Absorb schema and contract migration cost explicitly during phase change rather than hiding it in runtime drift.
Expose and compare conflicting implementations under stress without prematurely selecting a winner.
Preserve a low-overhead path for stable low-pressure work while keeping full invariants intact.
Measure whether entropy, authority overlap, generated backlog, and CI debt are low enough for final solidification.
Define the final one-way release gate without invoking it during gas, liquid, mixed, or supercritical development.

concerns.name: canonical law
concerns.slice: Define identities, units, ownership, and the invariant that survives every phase.

concerns.name: durable state
concerns.slice: Persist phase/control state crash-safely with explicit migration and rollback semantics.

concerns.name: versioned contract
concerns.slice: Expose the signal and decision through a deterministic versioned backend contract.

concerns.name: Airflow integration
concerns.slice: Integrate the control law into Airflow-owned lifecycle orchestration only.

concerns.name: operator mechanics
concerns.slice: Expose inspection, explanation, override boundaries, and repair in CLI/TUI surfaces.

concerns.name: security and isolation
concerns.slice: Apply least privilege, trust-zone checks, tenant isolation, and fail-closed behavior.

concerns.name: failure dynamics
concerns.slice: Specify retry, timeout, cancellation, stale writer, ambiguous result, and restart behavior.

concerns.name: stress envelope
concerns.slice: Bound concurrency, pressure, hysteresis, fairness, overload, and provider saturation.

concerns.name: evidence and metrics
concerns.slice: Record phase, signal, decision, latency, cost, refusal, and repair outcomes.

concerns.name: pre-crystal convergence
concerns.slice: Prepare deterministic entropy collapse while explicitly refusing premature crystallization.
